audit_items.proof_trace: Implementation only checks HasNode(parentRoot) which verifies parent exists in fork choice store, but does NOT verify the spec requirement: get_checkpoint_block(store, parent_root, finalized_epoch) == finalized_root. The ancestry check from parent to finalized checkpoint is completely missing.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker gossips data column sidecars for blocks on non-finalized forks. If parent_root exists in fork choice (was seen before), HasNode passes even though the block doesn't descend from finalized checkpoint, violating the spec and allowing propagation of invalid sidecars.
